scientific_integrity: Analytical proof, exact rational witness, and supplementary checker supplied; no external or independent certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact deterministic positive-outbreak branch of the closed rank-one mixing SIR model, not stochastic outbreak probability or finite-population extinction.
Fixed known finite susceptibility support and fixed trait marginals; no inference about unknown or continuous susceptibility support.
Standard Vandermonde and divided-difference tools are prior mathematical methods; historical priority outside inspected sources is not independently established.
title: A sharp mixed-moment cutoff and alternating final-size order in heterogeneous SIR epidemics
